productionImpact.difference: Supported encoder-clock expression produces a different rational under the pinned Linux glibc 2.36 reference and the current JavaScript math profile.

interpretation: Observed cast differences are consistent with x86 invalid conversions versus AArch64 saturation. Signed-zero/libm differences need explicit compiler/runtime profile handling. This does not certify an exhaustive cause or domain.
remaining: Exact exp2/libm implementation for the Linux reference

publicExpressionApi.note: Public avutil expression API uses explicit numeric profiles. Existing CLI encoder expression path remains separate. CPUID is now measured; previous /proc/cpuinfo-based records did not establish x86 feature availability. Current container exposes FMA and AVX2. Sample agreement does not prove libc dispatch or exhaustive equivalence.
